description: Course catalogue shared by all LMS connectors (Microsoft Viva Learning, Degreed CSV, own connectors): each course per language with title, short description, description, duration, format, level, learning objectives, skills, 16:9 and 3:2 thumbnails, deep link, provider, active flag and last change. source = standard (from code) or saved (changed via update_lms_catalog_entry). Also returns the public feed URLs. No prices.

course.description: only this course key, e.g. user, developer, consultant, user_compact

language.description: only this language (de | en); default both

name: list_lms_catalog
